101-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

323-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
323-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Falkenrath Noble and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1669-5145-5466-8095.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5006-8095--23.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-5006-8095--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1
Repeat.

2646-6495--5.easyPrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2646-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
2646-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1308-3129-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5982-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5982-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1637-3946-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

803-4302-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3334-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Lae'zel.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

423-872-1437-3861--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-1437-3861--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
5256-6972-7237.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-1233-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-1233-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

176-560-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-5226-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-5226-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-5517-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

145-1995-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.

640-1497-2173-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

813-2104-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Splash Portal.
813-2104-5895.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

11-2959-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-2959-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Heat Shimmer, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Heat Shimmer
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Heat Shimmer.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Heat Shimmer to your hand and creating a copy of Heat Shimmer targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Heat Shimmer copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Heat Shimmer.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that deals damage or causes lifeloss to each opponent

1542-3765--102.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
1542-3765--102.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery that deals damage or causes lifeloss by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {5}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the instant or sorcery cast in step 1, causing each opponent to lose at least 1 life or be dealt at least 1 damage.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

413-856-2279-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-2279-4321.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1829-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1829-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

440-1339-2999-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2999-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

215-950-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-950-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Fatestitcher any number of times.

662-1543-3364-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Arlinn has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
662-1543-3364-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Arlinn to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Arlinn.
Activate Arlinn by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

380-803-2232-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
When the Biovisionary token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Repeat steps 1 though 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the Biovisionary token, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1806-2034-2604-3002.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1800-2047.notablePrerequisites:
Old Gnawbone does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Old Gnawbone.
1800-2047.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Old Gnawbone.
Old Gnawbone triggers, creating seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U}, attaching it to a Treasure token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to win the game.

147-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
